Questions

What clients ask before booking

Do I need to be home?

Not at all. Most clients leave a key with building management. We send the photo report to your LINE when we finish — but you are very welcome to be there for the walkthrough.

Do I need to provide anything?

Nothing. Our team brings every tool and product. If you prefer a specific product, or are sensitive to certain scents, just tell us when you book.

Does the team speak English?

Yes. Every booking includes at least one English-speaking housekeeper, and our LINE admin replies in both Thai and English.

How and when do I pay?

Only after the job is done and inspected. We accept cash, bank transfer and PromptPay. No deposit for standard bookings.

What if I am not satisfied?

Tell us within 24 hours with a photo of what fell short. We return and redo it at no charge — and if it still is not right, we refund that portion.

Do you work outside Bangkok?

We cover Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani and Samut Prakan. Ask us about anywhere else — we can often arrange it with a travel supplement.
